sources.title: HQ-194, Eagle Has Landed: The Flight of Apollo 11
sources.context: Complete NASA HQ-194 documentary through its end credits, covering launch, Moon operations, return, recovery and quarantine. The source derivative also contains a colour-bar leader and unrelated silent press-room footage; these are omitted.

credits: NASA / Kennedy Space Center / Johnson Space Center. Original HQ-194 end credits are retained.
editorial_basis: User request: JFK speech through Apollo 11's return to Earth; this is an archive programme, with NASA's original technical reconstructions.
